title: Level normalization for the transported étale selected extension
statement:
For every core transported selected-extension datum, the derived selected extension has the normalized comparison at every coefficient level, together with the universal cochain normalization. Precisely:
```lean
theorem etaleCofinalExtension_level_normalization
    {W : Scheme.{u}} {l : ℕ} {B : Coefficients.{u} l} {r : ℕ ↪o ℕ}
    (core : CofinalExtensionCore W B r) :
    Nonempty { level : ∀ (m : ℕ) (eb : Evaluation W B.rings m)
      (er : Evaluation W (cofinalCoefficients B r).rings
        (SheafOfModules.systemNextSelected r m)),
      core.model.derived ⋙ eb.E ≅ er.E ⋙ scalarExtension
        (B.rings.map
          (homOfLE (SheafOfModules.systemNextSelected_spec r m).1).op).hom W //
      cofinalLevelNormalization (W := W) (B := B) (r := r)
        core.model core.ordinaryLevel level }
```

proof.text: Resolve on the actual ringed sequence site by simultaneous flat-term K-flat complexes. Evaluation preserves these representatives, and componentwise scalar extension preserves their quasi-isomorphisms. The normalized derived-extension construction then supplies the level isomorphisms and its universal cochain comparison, while the acyclic K-flat cone argument extends the formula to arbitrary K-flat complexes.
